# QCA Framework: Legacy Modernization & AI-Driven Engineering Pipeline

> QCA (Quantitative Code Analysis) is an enterprise-grade, deterministic AI compiler pipeline designed to modernize legacy monoliths (COBOL, FoxPro, 1C, old PHP) into secure, strictly-typed C# .NET 8 microservices without losing business logic.

## 🏛️ Core Architecture & Philosophy
- **Digital Sovereignty (100% On-Premise):** Designed for bare-metal servers or isolated Docker clusters. No core intellectual property leaves the corporate perimeter.
- **Deterministic AST Parsing:** Code is never fed as raw text to LLMs. It is parsed into Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) and transformed into strict Intermediate Representation (IR) JSON models.
- **The Pantheon of AI Agents:** Orchestration of specialized expert personas ("The Shaman", "The Blacksmith", "The Chronicler") operating under strict system constraints (Temperature 0.1 - 0.2).
- **The Pragmatic Downgrade:** Using tactical legacy tech (Python/PHP) for edge scraping and data sanitization, while maintaining a pure C# .NET 8 transactional core.
